method_limits: Changed full scanout images and guest flips are not proof of native title FPS or 100% guest speed.
QEMU display refresh callbacks are not guest VBlank or physical display refresh.
Same stationary scene is repeatable but ambient animations and racing AI are not deterministic.
Thread CPU percentages use one logical CPU as 100%; sampled CPU IDs are not residency estimates.
Audio fractions use the available counter window, which is shorter than the capture; queue inventory differences are not proven clock drift.
EP work-budget overruns differ from actual audio callback underruns.
Wall work/condition wait includes preemption and mutex reacquisition; inclusive native report percentages overlap.

Thermal HAL is unavailable; periodic sysfs/frequency snapshots cannot establish all throttling behavior. Requested one-second waits plus ADB overhead yield roughly 1.6–1.8 second median spacing in representative runs; exact spacing is recorded.
AC-powered battery current is zero; battery/energy improvement is unmeasured.
Failed or overlapping original baseline captures 1 and 2 are excluded.

selected_defaults.voice_pool: Discovered performance-core count, capped at four; unknown topology at most two; clamp to allowed CPUs.

sega_apu_participation.outcome: First-phase improvement did not reproduce. Keep owner participation opt-in.

pandora_apu_participation.outcome: Owner participation improved Pandora audio in the bracketed scene (4.83%/3.61%/4.81%), with a ~12% lower VP wall cost per frame and only 1–2% cadence differences. Isolated ~3s image gaps occur in both modes. Keep opt-in because Sega did not reproduce the benefit.

sega_tcg_placement.outcome: Both prime phases increased audio underruns. Keep scheduler-default placement.

surface_lifecycle.resume_method: Launcher then Back from temporary frontend to existing non-exported game activity
surface_lifecycle.initial_launcher_attempt: Emulator stayed alive and worker retired; launcher reopened frontend, so direct game resume required task navigation.
